_note: Pool vocabulary (D-1). Translates each submission's Merit standard values into one pool list per factor. Network tiers are a monitoring dimension placed by rate-table column position, not a burning-cost ranking. Values not found map to 'Unmapped' and are counted by G2.3; nothing is guessed. Entries marked status 'proposed' need the owner's confirmation before Stream 2 uses them on real data.

network._decision: D-1, tier map v1 2026-10-25; roll-up accepted 2026-10-25 16:35
network.match: TPA upper-cased, network trimmed and upper-cased; exact match only

notes.AAFIYA:APN (ENHANCED EBP): VN tier and also the mandatory-basic segment (SPEC Stream 2 step 4)

network._open: Names are exactly as in the owner's table. Whether AAFIYA 'APN Edge / Essential' is one network or two ('APN Edge', 'Essential') is open (HANDOVER Q7); until answered only the literal name maps.

regulator._decision: D-1: three regulator regions; provider emirate + Outside UAE kept as a claims attribute

benefit._decision: D-1: six groups; bundled pharmacy labelled, never split

pharmacy_rule.rule: FOB Out-Patient on a line whose Provider Type is Pharmacy -> Pharmacy; a TPA with no Pharmacy provider type in the submission -> its Out-Patient lines are OP_INCL_PHARMACY
pharmacy_rule.why: Merit's FOB list has no Pharmacy class; pharmacy is visible only through Provider Type

unmapped_fob.note: Merit standard FOB values outside the six groups: Unmapped (G2.3) until the owner assigns them

benefit._open: D-1 decided six groups; the group codes, labels and the FOB -> group map below are proposed by Claude from Merit's FOB list and need the owner's confirmation (HANDOVER Q2, Q3).

mandatory_basic.rule: Network or plan marked EBP / Basic (e.g. AAFIYA APN (Enhanced EBP)); never blended with enhanced plans

excluded.rule: identification rule to be confirmed (which Merit field marks a government-funded scheme)
